description: Full Kaggle run with the 2.5D (stacked) input and early stopping (lungnodule 0.8.0 notebook, QUICK_RUN = False)

model.weights: yolov5su.pt (Ultralytics YOLOv5s with an anchor-free head)

cpm_interval.method: percentile bootstrap over the 88 test scans (lungnodule.froc.bootstrap_cpm, seed 0)

comparison_with_gray_run.baseline: results/luna16-subset9 (gray input, 100 epochs, no early stopping)
comparison_with_gray_run.method: paired bootstrap over the same 88 test scans (lungnodule compare, seed 0)
comparison_with_gray_run.caveat: One training run per input. The runs also differ in early stopping; a gray run with the same settings is the clean control.

verification: Re-scored offline with lungnodule score and with the Python 3 port of the official LUNA16 algorithm (tests/test_froc_official.py): CPM 0.8612 in both, identical to the Kaggle run.

files.candidates.csv: The run's 2,222 candidates in the LUNA16 submission format
files.training_curves.png: Ultralytics training and validation curves (81 epochs, early stopping)
files.test_scans.txt: Series UIDs of the 88 test scans (LUNA16 subset 9), for --scans
files.by_size.json: Detected nodules by size at 0.125, 1 and 8 false positives per scan (lungnodule breakdown)
files.comparison_with_gray.json: Paired comparison with the gray run (lungnodule compare)
files.eigencam.csv, eigencam.json, eigencam.pn: Eigen-CAM box energy of the top 200 candidates, its summary and example maps (lungnodule explain)

reproduce: lungnodule score --candidates candidates.csv --annotations annotations.csv --excluded annotations_excluded.csv --scans test_scans.txt
